children.text: Battle Brothers is a challenging game. Losses and comebacks are part of the gameplay. It's recommended that you start with 'Beginner' difficulty and the tutorial origin!

children.text: You are second-in-command in a mercenary company that has been tracking a brigand named Hoggart for some time now. An unexpected turn of events leaves the company in shatters, and you in charge to rebuild it to its former glory.
Recommended for new players as it includes some helpful guidance in the beginning.
